headline: UK and Google DeepMind report early PlanAssist results as live pilot expands to 15 councils
summary: The UK Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government says early PlanAssist testing with Barnet, Camden and Dorset cut officer time on key householder-application assessment tasks by 58%, and says this is helping halve routine processing times from eight weeks to four. It is expanding live testing to 12 more councils for a 12-month phase. Google DeepMind separately reports that officers approved more than 70% of generated reports without edits. These are provider-reported early measures: the sources do not disclose sample sizes, denominators, comparison design or how assessment-task time maps to end-to-end processing time. Planning officers retain review and decision authority; wider availability depends on successful testing.
